## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The dispatch-result schema accepts an escalation_request with a target tier...

The system SHALL ensure that the dispatch-result schema accepts an escalation_request with a target tier or vendor or human, a reason, and evidence refs.

#### Scenario: The dispatch-result schema accepts an escalation_request with a target tier...

WHEN `add-escalation-request-to-the-dispatch-result-envelope` is implemented
THEN The dispatch-result schema accepts an escalation_request with a target tier or vendor or human, a reason, and evidence refs.

### Requirement: Schema tests reject escalation requests that lack a reason, name an unknown...

The system SHALL ensure that schema tests reject escalation requests that lack a reason, name an unknown target, or carry malformed evidence refs.

#### Scenario: Schema tests reject escalation requests that lack a reason, name an unknown...

WHEN `add-escalation-request-to-the-dispatch-result-envelope` is implemented
THEN Schema tests reject escalation requests that lack a reason, name an unknown target, or carry malformed evidence refs.

### Requirement: Existing dispatch results without escalation_request still validate, so...

The system SHALL ensure that existing dispatch results without escalation_request still validate, so ri-21 producers need no change.

#### Scenario: Existing dispatch results without escalation_request still validate, so...

WHEN `add-escalation-request-to-the-dispatch-result-envelope` is implemented
THEN Existing dispatch results without escalation_request still validate, so ri-21 producers need no change.
